event: The rupiah closed at Rp18,256 per US dollar on 17 November, slightly stronger by 0.07% per Bisnis, after detikFinance said the dollar was almost Rp18,300 in the morning. (update of E0858)

event: KSPI president and presidential adviser Said Iqbal said President Prabowo has not decided who will manage the planned severance (pesangon) reserve fund, with BPJS Ketenagakerjaan, Danantara or a new body as options, and that he leans to Danantara.
key_numbers: 3 options: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan, Danantara (BPI), new body · BPJS route needs amending 2 laws (SJSN, BPJS Ketenagakerjaan) · Danantara route could be a government regulation · no rupiah amounts given · press conference 16 Nov

event: OJK announced it named suspects, three of them detained, over alleged manipulation of warrant trading on the IDX involving accounts opened with other people's identities.
key_numbers: 4 suspects named, 3 detained (held at Bareskrim) · estimated loss Rp6.97 billion (headline says 3 suspects) · trading day 29 May 2023 · instruments CHEM-W, DOOH-W and 3 structured warrants · OJK investigation order May 2026

event: LPSK said restitution for 5,102 qualified victims of the Dana Syariah Indonesia (DSI) P2P lending fraud totals Rp1.07 trillion, and its report went to Kejari Depok on 21 October.
key_numbers: 5,102 victims · Rp1.07T total restitution (about Rp209 million per victim, our calc) · applications 1 Apr-16 May 2026 · report to Kejari Depok 21 Oct 2026

event: OJK's banking supervision head Dian Ediana Rae said OJK is still drafting policy on bank consolidation and capital (modal inti) requirements, to be applied gradually, while CNBC also reported OJK drafting rules for mini banks to upgrade.
key_numbers: No threshold, bank count or deadline disclosed · 2027 capital deadline mentioned · OJK also warned banks on lending amid weak purchasing power

event: Because the MPR plenary to choose a new Vice President moved from 2 December to 9 December, the 18 November date for Prabowo to hand over two candidate names no longer appears to be the binding deadline. (update of E0866)
key_numbers: Plenary 2 Dec -> 9 Dec 2026 · rule: names at least 14 days before plenary (Peraturan MPR 1/2024 Art. 136(1)) · implied new latest date about 25 Nov 2026 (our calculation, not stated by MPR) · 2 names required
sources: detikNews (via E0866) <https://news.detik.com/berita/d-8755839/sidang-mpr-pemilihan-wapres-mundur-sepekan-ini-pertimbangannya> ; afu.id (14-day rule, 18 Nov date) <https://afu.id/nasional/prabowo-beri-parpol-sepekan-dua-nama-cawapres-kejar-tenggat-mpr-18-november>

event: CNBC Indonesia, citing the Straits Times and a government source, reported that Polri searched the Jakarta office of Singapore-based Megaspeed at the FBI's request in search of Nvidia chips, finding server racks with no GPUs. (update of E0716)
key_numbers: Megaspeed Nvidia purchases over US$4.8 billion since June 2024 (largest SE Asia buyer) · MettaDC Cikarang 36 MW · raid reportedly early 2026, before the scandal went public · no police statement

event: Indosat denied any commercial relationship with Megaspeed, while a NexAI Digital Infrastruktur disclosure names both Megaspeed International Indonesia and Indosat as tenants of the MettaDC Cikarang and planned Batang data centres.
key_numbers: Indosat: no commercial relationship · MettaDC 36 MW Cikarang · planned Batang 60 MW · Megaspeed purchases US$4.8 billion since Jun 2024 · no GPU count for Indonesia given

event: CNBC Indonesia, citing the State of Scams Indonesia 2026 report, said Indonesians lost Rp104.3 trillion to digital scams over the past year, with nearly half of victims scammed more than once.
key_numbers: Total loss Rp104.3T · average loss Rp4.89 million per victim · median Rp1.24 million · 70% of adults faced a scam attempt (66% in 2025) · 63 attempts per person per year · 47% of victims scammed repeatedly · survey of 1,160 adults, 16 Mar-13 Apr 2026 · OJK digital fraud reports above 700,000 (CNBC, 16 Nov, headline only)

event: Bareskrim Polri announced it had blocked 322 bank accounts and seized Rp28.01 billion in a probe of an online gambling site identified only as 'A', whose servers are in Finland and the US.
key_numbers: 322 blocked accounts · Rp28.01 billion seized (may rise) · servers in Finland and US · site still operating, reachable via VPN despite Komdigi block · no suspect named

event: CNBC Indonesia reported that Uber notified drivers that 149,346 people had their names, addresses, birth dates and driver's licence numbers stolen through a breach at third-party AI provider Fireworks AI.
key_numbers: 149,346 drivers · data: name, address, date of birth, driver's licence number · notices began early Nov 2026 · Uber's second breach in 2026 (after Uber Freight) · drivers' countries not stated

event: CNBC Indonesia reported Microsoft's explanation of the 13 November global Microsoft 365 outage: a gateway-server bug from a July change, undetected for about three months, cascaded failures across servers. (update of E0816)
key_numbers: Bug undetected ~3 months · ~14% of gateway capacity already offline · servers overwhelmed up to 80% · Teams switched gateways ~15 hours before outage · Microsoft apologised

key_numbers: Chip Hackathon 2026: 89 teams, 338 students, 41 universities · no process node, fab or production target stated
